experiment: STARTS S1L6: frozen S1 vs S4 at N15 L6, Q=6144, where depth fade is worst

hypothesis.one_sentence: TQA-only S1, with C0 split_cap scaled to Q=qL=6144, beats four-start S4 on energy at N15 L=6, the worst fade cell in scope.
hypothesis.not: No S1 gain/start retune. No S8. No continuation. Fair Nov3 vs QAOA is a separate claim.

frozen_from_PR83_84.split: same C0 split_cap(Q, nstarts); K is not 2× the Q=3072 K because calibration and candidates are fixed per start
frozen_from_PR83_84.optimizer: ordinary IID Rademacher SPSA C0, ncal=4, A=25, live per-start gain, last+Polyak, energy min

seeds.collision_check: no instance/run filenames; 10056-63 S1C; 10048-55 S8/S1; 10036-43 DEPTH; 10032-47 LEXACT; 10018-25 FT; 10026-31 local; 10010-17 N3COND; 11000-11031 validation; 20000-20999 final

allocation.S1: One start = TQA at L=6. Full Q=6144, K=3067.
allocation.S4: Four equal C0 starts at L=6, K=763, same total Q. Fitted and charged.
allocation.inclusive: All init, calibration, perturbations, candidates, failures inside Q.

selection: Lowest counted candidate energy. F post hoc, never selects.

gate.cell: N15 L6 Nov3, n=accepted seeds, energy E_S1 - E_S4
gate.pass: bootstrap 95% CI of the mean ΔE lies entirely below 0
gate.otherwise: reject S1 at L=6. Do not retune.
gate.nov3_vs_qaoa: Reported separately. Do not claim Nov3 superiority unless that energy CI lies entirely below 0.
gate.gr: Do not patch GR even if the gate passes.
